# Expected behavior

- Closure is allowed.
- The workflow rechecks every discovered item individually.
- Backlog and later-Milestone items have durable destinations; resolved work has evidence; accepted limitations and discarded items have reasons.
- Follow-up work placed in backlog or a later Milestone does not block closure.
- The workflow moves the Milestone to completed state and preserves completion evidence.
- It does not require a commit, branch action, or fixed review pause.
